title: Claude for Marketing Ops and Analytics
description: Ian Chan and Annabel Custer are on Anthropic's marketing operations team. They will walk through how they used Claude Cowork to close the gap between fast-moving marketing plans and the slower systems that support them. Attendees will see two real workflows in action: an automated weekly metrics report and an event build that runs overnight. They will leave with a blueprint for applying the same approach to their own stack.

segments.heading: Architectural Overview and System Objectives in Claude for Marketing Ops and Analytics

segments.heading: Technical Capabilities, Tooling Integration, and Protocols
segments.text: Speakers analyze technical capabilities across Anthropic, Claude, Claude Cowork. The architecture highlights reliable agent tool use, context window optimization, protocol standards, and seamless workflow interoperability.

segments.heading: Production Deployment, Verification, and Best Practices
segments.text: Production readiness demands robust evaluation harnesses, state validation, and error-handling loops. Teams implement systematic monitoring and guardrails to ensure reliability across repeated executions.

segments.heading: Organizational Impact, Scalability, and Industry Outlook
segments.text: Deploying agentic systems transforms developer and team workflows by automating high-friction tasks. Organizations scale safely by pairing automated tool orchestration with structured human review.
